recorded_against.note: Values here are this store's. Re-recording elsewhere will change them; what must not change without a reason is the shape of each tape.
recorded_against.agreement: The `legacy` and `agreed` fields are CONTEXT, not an assertion. AbstractTemplate::getProcessedTemplate() applies its own design config and cancels it again, so in a long-lived CLI process the design state a directive sees depends on what ran before it - Asset\Repository caches its defaults on first use, and an isolated {{css}} or {{view}} can resolve a different theme here than the same directive inside a real template. `template-parser diff` is the end-to-end parity measure and renders whole templates; this file exists for the tapes, which are store-independent and are where the guards live.
